# Haroon Shirzad — AI Developer, Builder & Technology Explorer

> "I don't just use AI tools. I build systems with them."

## About Haroon Shirzad
Haroon Shirzad is an AI-focused developer, builder, and technology explorer specializing in practical Artificial Intelligence applications, autonomous agent systems, cross-platform mobile engineering with Flutter/Dart, and workflow automation.

## Core Areas of Expertise & Interest
- **Artificial Intelligence**: Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Autonomous AI Agents, Multi-Model Routing, Prompt Engineering, Vector Search/RAG, Computer Vision, Voice AI.
- **Mobile & Frontend Engineering**: Flutter, Dart, CustomPainter 2D Graphics Engine, Native MethodChannels, Reactive State Management.
- **Backend, Cloud & Automation**: Google Firebase, Cloud Firestore, REST APIs, WebSockets, n8n Automation, Event-Driven Webhooks.
- **Foundation Models & Gateways**: Google Gemini (Pro/Flash), DeepSeek (V3/R1), OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter.
- **Emerging & Physical Computing**: Local LLMs (Ollama), Whisper & Piper Speech Pipelines, Robotics & Physical AI (ESP32/Microcontroller bridges).

## Key Projects & Systems
1. **BakhterGPT**: An evolving AI-powered mobile application built with Flutter featuring multi-provider model routing (Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenAI), multimodal vision processing, Firestore chat persistence, voice queries, and educational communication workflows.
2. **The Secrets of Universe**: An interactive Flutter astronomy application with planetary telemetry, NASA space images, celestial charts, and educational video streaming.
3. **Perfect Wallpaper**: A Flutter utility application for Android with native MethodChannels wallpaper management and asynchronous downloading.
4. **Sound Flow**: A dark-themed music streaming UI concept celebrating Afghan musical heritage and legendary artists (Concept project; no official artist partnerships).
5. **فرار از میر آغا (Escape from Mir Agha)**: A 2D arcade mobile game developed in Flutter using CustomPainter for 60fps canvas rendering, vector collisions, and Dari/Persian typography.
6. **Hospital AI Concept**: An architectural blueprint for a clinical multi-agent intelligence platform connecting patient triage, laboratory vision analysis, and hospital workflows (Research Concept).
7. **AI Employment / UNDP Concept**: A humanitarian-inspired conversational AI platform concept for skill-based talent discovery and economic opportunity matching (Research Concept).
8. **Autonomous AI Assistant (Jarvis Concept)**: An experimental AI assistant prototype for voice interaction, OS computer control, and future hardware actuation (Experimental Prototype).
